title: yummy algerian roast hash
description: a hearty and comforting dish featuring crispy bacon and tender vegetables
instructions: line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
arrange the chopped vegetables in a single layer on the prepared baking sheet.
drizzle the vegetables with a tablespoon of olive oil and sprinkle with salt and pepper.
roast the vegetables in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until tender and lightly browned.
cook the bacon in a large skillet over medium heat until crispy.
remove the bacon from the skillet and set aside.
add the chopped vegetables to the same skillet and cook until lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
serve the roasted vegetables with the crispy bacon on top.
garnish with fresh parsley, if desired.
